cohort: 371 women who delivered at Kilimanjaro Christian Medical Centre between April and May 2014, 162 with preterm delivery (cases) and 209 with term delivery (controls).
finding: Several maternal and obstetric factors, including living alone, no formal education, heavy physical work, being a peasant or businesswoman, history of stillbirth or miscarriage, preeclampsia, placenta previa, placental abruption, cesarean section delivery, inadequate ANC visits, multiple pregnancy, low birth weight, and UTIs during pregnancy, were associated with preterm delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with preterm delivery (OR 1.60, 95% CI: 1.06-2.43).
birth_weight: Low birth weight was associated with preterm delivery (OR 34.27, 95% CI: 15.93-73.7), but the specific weight cutoff is not provided.
